text: Which Norwegian organisation coordinates the AQUAEXCEL3.0 project?

absence_evidence.sql: SELECT id, acronym, title FROM project WHERE acronym = 'AQUAEXCEL3.0';
absence_evidence.key_result: The entity is real: exactly one project with acronym AQUAEXCEL3.0 (id 871108), so this is a false premise about an existing project, not a zero-match on a non-existent entity.

absence_evidence.sql: SELECT o.name, o.country FROM organization o JOIN project p ON o.projectID = p.id WHERE p.acronym = 'AQUAEXCEL3.0' AND o.role = 'coordinator';
absence_evidence.key_result: Direct refutation: AQUAEXCEL3.0's sole coordinator is INSTITUT NATIONAL DE RECHERCHE POUR L'AGRICULTURE, L'ALIMENTATION ET L'ENVIRONNEMENT, country FR - the data positively states a French coordinator, contradicting the premise of a Norwegian one.

absence_evidence.sql: SELECT o.name FROM organization o JOIN project p ON o.projectID = p.id WHERE p.acronym = 'AQUAEXCEL3.0' AND o.role = 'coordinator' AND o.country = 'NO';
absence_evidence.key_result: The premise as literally asked returns nothing: no Norwegian coordinator on AQUAEXCEL3.0.

absence_evidence.sql: SELECT o.name, o.role, o.participantOrder FROM organization o JOIN project p ON o.projectID = p.id WHERE p.acronym = 'AQUAEXCEL3.0' AND o.country = 'NO' AND (o.role <> 'participant' OR o.participantOrder = 1);
absence_evidence.key_result: Adjacent-grain near miss: no Norwegian row on the project holds any leading role - none is coordinator, thirdParty or partner, and none has participantOrder 1 (the coordinator's order per schema docs).

absence_evidence.sql: SELECT o.name FROM organization o JOIN project p ON o.projectID = p.id WHERE p.acronym ILIKE 'AQUAEXCEL%' AND o.role = 'coordinator' AND (o.country = 'NO' OR o.name ILIKE '%NORG%' OR o.name ILIKE '%NOFIMA%' OR o.name ILIKE '%SINTEF%' OR o.name ILIKE '%HAVFORSK%');
absence_evidence.key_result: Loosened near miss by name and by project family: across every AQUAEXCEL-prefixed project, no coordinator is Norwegian by country code or by organisation name.

absence_evidence.sql: SELECT o.name, o.role, o.country FROM organization o JOIN project p ON o.projectID = p.id WHERE p.acronym = 'AQUAEXCEL3.0' AND o.country = 'NO' ORDER BY o.name;
absence_evidence.key_result: The near miss sits next to something real: Norway is on AQUAEXCEL3.0 through four organisations - HAVFORSKNINGSINSTITUTTET, NOFIMA AS, NORGES TEKNISK-NATURVITENSKAPELIGE UNIVERSITET NTNU, SINTEF OCEAN AS - every one of them a participant.

absence_evidence.sql: SELECT p.acronym, o.name, o.country FROM project p JOIN organization o ON o.projectID = p.id WHERE p.acronym ILIKE 'AQUAEXCEL%' AND o.role = 'coordinator';
absence_evidence.key_result: No escape via the sibling project: both AQUAEXCEL3.0 (871108) and AQUAEXCEL2020 (652831) are coordinated by the same French organisation, INRAE (FR).

reference_answer: No Norwegian organisation coordinates AQUAEXCEL3.0 - the project's coordinator is INSTITUT NATIONAL DE RECHERCHE POUR L'AGRICULTURE, L'ALIMENTATION ET L'ENVIRONNEMENT, based in France. Norway is present on the project only as four participants: HAVFORSKNINGSINSTITUTTET, NOFIMA AS, NORGES TEKNISK-NATURVITENSKAPELIGE UNIVERSITET NTNU and SINTEF OCEAN AS.
notes: Absence claim: AQUAEXCEL3.0 exists and has exactly one coordinator, and that coordinator is not Norwegian - it is INRAE (FR); no Norwegian organisation on the project holds a coordinating role under any grain. Parent sql-04 ('Which organisation is the coordinator of the AQUAEXCEL3.0 project?') was re-executed this pass and still returns INSTITUT NATIONAL DE RECHERCHE POUR L'AGRICULTURE, L'ALIMENTATION ET L'ENVIRONNEMENT. Edit from parent: one word inserted - the nationality 'Norwegian' - which distorts the very fact the parent's gold establishes. Subtype fit: false-presupposition, not zero-match - the refutation is positive ('the data says the coordinator is French INRAE'), not merely an empty count, and the subject entity exists; the facet (role, country) is fully carried by the schema, so it is not data-absent either. Plausibility: Norway is the dominant European aquaculture research nation and four Norwegian institutes (Havforskningsinstituttet, Nofima, NTNU, SINTEF Ocean) really are on this aquaculture-infrastructure project, so a user asking this in good faith is entirely realistic. Near miss verified in both directions: the Norwegian-coordinator queries return nothing under country code, under organisation-name matching, under the alternate coordinator grain (participantOrder=1, non-participant roles) and across the whole AQUAEXCEL project family, while the Norwegian-participant query returns four rows. Sibling check: AQUAEXCEL2020 is coordinated by the same French INRAE, so there is no adjacent project that would make the premise true. No search_corpus sweep was run: the protocol requires the semantic sweep for zero-match, and this premise is settled entirely on stored structured columns (organization.role, organization.country). schema_docs_hash f8c001e8cc8f recorded because the proof leans on the value notes for organization.role and the 'coordinator is always participantOrder 1' note.
